text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: service=model-routing image=registry/redwood/model-routing:v2.2.3 
deploy-bot: feature flag ff_new_routing=ON for cohort=canary-5 (5%) region=us-west1. auto-increase to 25% after 10m if error_rate < 0.5%
sara: ack. monitoring dashboards up. pin strategy? consider pinning traffic to 2.2.2 if unstable
adi: prepping rollback runbook now, will stand by for metrics
matt: if 5xx > 0.8% or p95 latency +20ms -> pause and flip ff_new_routing OFF. paging oncall if triggered
deploy-bot: Canary check @+10m: p95 latency +30ms, 5xx rate 0.9% -> pausing auto-increase and disabling ff_new_routing per policy
oncall-bot: alert created: INCIDENT-2024-642 -> paging #incidents, severity=warning
julia: seeing repeated kv-cache-mismatch errors in canary logs, sample:
```
2024-06-15T23:12:03Z model-routing[canary-1] ERROR kv_cache.cpp: failed deserialize chunk: model_quant_table mismatch
2024-06-15T23:12:04Z model-routing[canary-1] WARN infer: fallback to CPU path, latency spike
```
sara: that matches hypothesis about quantization path differences between 2.2.2 and 2.2.3. suggest rollback to 2.2.2 and keep ff disabled until fix
matt: agreed. command to rollback for ops: `kubectl set image deploy/model-routing model-routing=registry/redwood/model-routing:v2.2.2 --namespace=prod` or run `scripts/rollback.sh model-routing v2.2.2`
adi: running rollback job now, keeping canary cohort in read-only route until drain completes
deploy-bot: rollback job started, disabling ff_new_routing globally, draining canary cohorts (5%)
sara: updated release notes draft in /docs/releases/2024-06-15.md: "v2.2.3 rolled back -> reverted to v2.2.2 due to 5xx increase in canary; investigating quantization fallback"
adi: rollback finished @+7m, all canaries back to v2.2.2, ff_new_routing remains OFF, monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline
matt: leaving a hold for 24h on re-rollout until we have a targeted regression test for quantized models and an added canary gate for kv-cache errors
julia: creating repro test and small perf harness for quantized path, will post PR soon
oncall-bot: INCIDENT-2024-642 status -> resolved (root cause investigation ongoing)
sara: thanks all. follow-up: update deploy playbook to include explicit quantization healthcheck and add an automated rollback trigger at 0.7% 5xx for model-routing. posting summary in #eng-releases and will prep postmortem template
matt: +1, assign owners and ETA in the postmortem. good catch everyone :thumbsup:
